My teaching and mentoring experience includes undergraduate courses in mathematics and optimization, directed reading groups, and coaching high-school students in preparation for national mathematics competitions in Russia.

## Teaching and Mentoring Experience

- **Teaching Assistant --- MATH 221: Honors Calculus III**  
  *Rice University · Fall 2026*  
  Hold office hours, lead recitation sessions, and run weekly proof-writing tutorials for groups of 3-4 students.

- **[Directed Reading Program](https://mathweb.rice.edu/directed-reading-program) Organizer --- Applications of Linear Algebra**  
  *Rice University · Spring 2026*  
  Organized a directed reading group on applications of linear algebra, with an emphasis on geometry, algorithms, and optimization (see [schedule and topics](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1J_3LoaARyf10piFmOvUceF6997kdvSCfeQN4c0UNBRU/edit?usp=sharing){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}). Selected readings included:
  - J. Matoušek and B. Gärtner, *Understanding and Using Linear Programming*
  - J. Matoušek, *Thirty-three Miniatures: Mathematical and Algorithmic Applications of Linear Algebra*
  - Sheldon Axler, [“Down with Determinants!”](https://www.axler.net/DwD.html){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}, *American Mathematical Monthly* 102 (1995), 139–154

- **Mathematics Instructor --- Techniques of a Pro Mathematician**  
  *Tapia Camps, Rice University · Summer 2025*  
  Taught a week-long course for high-school students on mathematical problem solving and proof strategies.

- **Teaching Assistant --- CMOR 360: Introduction to Optimization and Operations Research**  
  *Rice University · Spring 2025*  
  Held recitation sessions and office hours, created and graded assignments, and assisted students with course material.

- **Competitive Mathematics Coach**  
  *Lyceum “The Second School” · September 2021–May 2022*  
  Led two weekly two-hour classes for students preparing for national and regional mathematics competitions.
